headline: Bitcoin Holds Near $83,000 as Sentiment Stays in Greed
narrative: Bitcoin was trading near $83,000 on Monday, with the Fear and Greed Index at 69, a greed reading short of euphoria. The dollar index on the flow board stood at 102.6, offering no confirmation of a weak-dollar bid. Stablecoin supply remained near $305 billion to $311 billion, little changed since January, after an earlier model headline wrongly reported a 300 percent expansion.
author: jordan
sources: stablecoin trackers year to date flat
